spec.description: Metrics of an Arma network: routers, batchers, consenters and assemblers, split per party and per shard. Provisioned by the sample in examples/grafana, which runs a network together with Prometheus and Grafana; see its README for how to start one.

spec.title: Assembler - Attestation to Batch Collation Latency

spec.expr:
sum by (party_id, shard_id) (
  rate(batcher_batch_mempool_next_requests_latency_seconds_sum[1m])
)
/
sum by (party_id, shard_id) (
  rate(batcher_batch_mempool_next_requests_latency_seconds_count[1m])
)

sum by (party_id, shard_id) (
  rate(batcher_batch_verify_latency_seconds_sum[1m])
)
/
sum by (party_id, shard_id) (
  rate(batcher_batch_verify_latency_seconds_count[1m])
)

sum by (party_id, shard_id) (
  rate(batch_ledger_append_latency_seconds_sum[1m])
)
/
sum by (party_id, shard_id) (
   rate(batch_ledger_append_latency_seconds_count[1m])
)

sum by (party_id, shard_id) (rate(batcher_batch_hashing_latency_seconds_sum[1m]))
/
sum by (party_id, shard_id) (rate(batcher_batch_hashing_latency_seconds_count[1m]))

sum by (party_id, shard_id) (rate(batch_ledger_header_hashing_latency_seconds_sum[1m]))
/
sum by (party_id, shard_id) (rate(batch_ledger_header_hashing_latency_seconds_count[1m]))
